extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Antinuclear antibody testing (ANA) (CPT code 86038, CPT code 86039) IS REIMBURSABLE up to three times per lifetime for the following conditions or symptoms:

Testing for rheumatoid factor (CPT code 86430, CPT code 86431) and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide (CPT code 86200) IS REIMBURSABLE up to three times per lifetime for the following conditions or symptoms:

Testing of double stranded deoxyribonucleic acid (dsDNA) (CPT code 86225, CPT code 0039U) IS REIMBURSABLE up to four times per year for the following conditions or symptoms:

For a wellness visit or a general encounter without abnormal findings, antinuclear antibodies (ANA) (CPT code 86038, CPT code 86039) or extractable nuclear antigen (ENA) (CPT code 86235) testing IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The use of cell-bound complement activation products, for example, Avise® Lupus (CPT code 0312U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Any other serum biomarker panel testing, with or without proprietary algorithms or index scores, designed to diagnose, prognose, or monitor systemic lupus erythematosus or connective tissue diseases (CPT code 0062U, CPT code 0446U*, CPT code 0447U*, CPT code 0522U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
